note: Cases for the board script grammar. scripts/board_script.py and assets/html-runtime/board.js must both accept every ok:true case and reject every ok:false case with a message containing error_contains.

cases.name: open not boolean
cases.error_contains: open must be true or false

cases.name: say too long
cases.error_contains: say must be text of at most 600

cases.name: too many actions in a step
delay too long
cases.error_contains: delay must be a number from 0 to 60

cases.name: duration too short
cases.error_contains: duration must be a number from 0.1 to 30

cases.name: width too large
cases.error_contains: width must be a number from 0.2 to 2

cases.name: radius too large
cases.error_contains: r must be a number up to 80

cases.name: path does not start with M
path wrong arity
cases.error_contains: wrong number of values for L
